cut_en: panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: a pure black empty frame. Bottom: medium shot, static camera, eye level, front view: Dongmin in the center hugging a paint-can drum, two wooden spoons raised, frozen mid-strike, eyebrows raised in an aggrieved look; Seonyoung at the left edge in oversized black rubber boots leaning in urgently with the spoon-handle baton. Soft diffused afternoon light through the tent canvas.

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: long shot, eye level: Seonyoung crossing the muddy embankment road on a Saturday morning, hugging an empty violin case to her chest, splashing in oversized black rubber boots, low morning sun from the left. Bottom: long shot along a mainland back alley at midday: Manseok, slightly stooped, pulling an empty handcart away from camera, high sun, short shadows.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, rubber boots, bare hands (the white cotton gloves stuffed in the jacket pocket)

cut_en: panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: chibi comedic reaction, 2-3 heads tall: Seonyoung's baton goes up and the four children blast their scrap instruments, Mija blowing the drainpipe trumpet far too hard, Deoksu a beat late on the oil-can cello. Bottom: normal proportions, medium shot, eye level: Eunju on the left with the tin-can violin under her chin, head tilted slightly left; Mija on the right raising the drainpipe trumpet, chin out. Diffused tent light.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, rubber boots, bare hands (the white cotton gloves stuffed in the jacket pocket)

cut_en: extreme close-up, side view: Eunju's left ear and profile, the tin-can violin body resting under her chin, her head tilting slightly to the left, eyes lowered and still. A wide band of dull muted teal sound waves washes over the top of the frame from the right, and beneath it one thin thread of golden light rises from the can body into her ear. Diffused tent light.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, rubber boots, bare hands (the white cotton gloves stuffed in the jacket pocket)

cut_en: panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: bust shot, eye level: Eunju on the left speaking calmly, mouth corners not moving; Deoksu on the right bursting into a snort while chewing scorched rice, crumbs flying. Bottom: chibi comedic reaction, 2-3 heads tall, high angle looking down: Deoksu lying flat on his back on the low platform hugging the oil-can cello, a snapped string whipping away into the air on the side away from him, a scorched-rice cracker still in his mouth, kids' faces peering down at the frame edge.

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: long shot, eye level: at the island entrance in the afternoon, old Kwak and a few island men in dark work clothes wheel a broken upright piano in on a handcart. Bottom: medium shot: old Kwak, back straight, has pried open the piano's belly, dozens of thick steel strings exposed; he holds up a bundle of piano wire in one hand with a blunt, unsmiling face. Afternoon side light.

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: chibi comedic reaction, 2-3 heads tall: the spoon-handle baton slipping out of Seonyoung's hand and spinning through the air into the huge iron soup pot with a splash. Bottom: normal proportions, medium shot: grandma Sunrye fishing the baton out with her ladle and holding it out after tapping it on a dish towel, deadpan; Seonyoung flustered, bowing as she takes it, glasses askew; children in the background slapping the platform, laughing.

tall panel split horizontally into four frames. 1: an October river wind lifting the tent flap, only a few flies over the trash hill, cool clear light. 2: extreme close-up of Eunju's bare left fingertips with fresh calluses. 3: on the trash hill at midday, Eunju in cotton work gloves sorting scrap, her gloved left fingers pressing invisible strings in the air. 4: extreme close-up of her lips moving silently as she taps a tin can with a short iron rod in gloved hands.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, rubber boots, bare hands (the white cotton gloves stuffed in the jacket pocket)

cut_en: panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: full shot, eye level: five people in one frame in front of the platform under a bare bulb, Seonyoung at left foreground with the baton tip just flicked, the four children frozen mid-note on their scrap instruments, as if the image has stopped. Bottom: static close shot of the bare bulb swinging on its cord, warm light sliding across the canvas, quiet composition, empty negative space.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, rubber boots, bare hands (the white cotton gloves stuffed in the jacket pocket)

cut_en: panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: bust shot, eye level, two-shot: Dongmin on the right looking up at Eunju, asking timidly; Eunju on the left answering after a half-beat pause, eyes front, mouth corners not moving. Bottom: close-up, front view: Seonyoung holding the baton, taking off her round glasses to wipe them on her shirt tail, lips trembling, the warm bulb light reflected in the lenses.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: insert shot of a leaflet with unreadable blank columns suggesting text on Seonyoung's knee, a bus token in her palm. Bottom: wide establishing shot from the back door: a school orchestra in navy blazers playing furiously at the front, Taejun in the front chair leading with his bow; the island children and Seonyoung in the last row hugging sacks on their laps, Seonyoung leaning over to whisper. Flat white fluorescent light, a band of window sun.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: extreme close-up, side view: Eunju's left ear and profile as she tilts her head slightly to the left, eyes half-closed. One thick wave of cool blue light rolling in from the orchestra unravels near her ear like a skein of thread into dozens of thin separate blue light ribbons, one for each string. Flat fluorescent light.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: medium shot: a young staff member in a navy blazer at the back turns a page and tilts his head, puzzled. Bottom: four narrow insert strips in a row: the island children unwrapping sacks one by one, a powdered-milk can violin, an oil-can cello, a drainpipe trumpet, a paint-can drum; students in the nearby rows smirking behind their hands.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: over-the-shoulder shot past Eunju's blurred shoulder and the tin-can violin: Taejun seated one row ahead, only his head turned to look at the can, polite but cold eyes, thin lips pressed. Bottom: extreme close-up of the spoon-handle baton tip trembling in Seonyoung's raised hand, her fingertips pale.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: long shot, eye level: in the back, Dongmin striking the paint-can drum too early, Mija blowing the drainpipe trumpet in panic, Deoksu late on the oil-can cello; the whole room collapsing in laughter, one student sliding off his chair. In the right foreground Taejun alone does not laugh, calmly wiping rosin dust off his violin strings with a cloth, not stopping his hand. Flat fluorescent light.

medium shot, eye level: Mija on the left setting down the drainpipe trumpet and stepping forward, shouting, fists tight; Seonyoung in the center clutching Mija's sleeve with both hands to hold her back, her glasses slid down to the tip of her nose; Taejun seated in the right background, unmoved. Flat fluorescent light.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: high angle close-up of Eunju's hands: a small silver tuning fork tapped on her knee and touched to the tin-can body, silvery white light rings spreading and merging with the string's vibration as she turns a wooden peg. Bottom: from Taejun's side, his cloth-holding hand stopped in the foreground: Eunju drawing the bow across two strings, warm golden light swelling from the can as one steady ring, the laughing room behind gone gray.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: extreme close-up, side view: Eunju's left ear in sharp focus, head tilting slightly left; behind her, blurred, Taejun absently plucking the A string of his violin. In front of her ear a cool blue ring from the pluck overlaps a fading silvery white ring and the two shimmer slightly out of step, a fine wavering interference pattern between them.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into three frames. 1: bust shot: Eunju speaking flatly after a half-beat pause, not looking straight at him, mouth corners still. 2: extreme close-up of Taejun's left fingers frozen on the A string of his violin. 3: a brief desaturated flashback insert of Eunju tapping the tuning fork once on her knee.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: close-up, eye level: in the foreground Taejun's fingertips on the violin string, drained pale and trembling very slightly; behind them his face glancing toward the front rows where his orchestra mates are still laughing and not looking; Eunju small in the left background, already turning back to her tin can. Flat fluorescent light.

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: bust shot: Taejun rubbing his eyes with the back of his hand. Bottom: high angle extreme close-up of his hands laying the violin in a fine velvet-lined case and pressing the latch, which slips the first time and catches on the second.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: wide establishing shot of the whole rehearsal room: a band of warm sun through the tall windows, a few students have hung their blazers on chair backs, someone fanning with a leaflet. In the center foreground Dongmin tugs the hem of Eunju's jacket and asks quietly; Eunju answers without looking toward Taejun. Nobody looks cold.

tall panel split horizontally into three frames. 1: extreme long shot, static camera from the island end of the embankment road: Mr. Choi in a gray suit crossing far away, a manila envelope under his arm, cold clear light from the right. 2: insert of a paper sticking out of the envelope, unreadable blank columns suggesting text. 3: low shot of his shiny shoes stuck in the mud, one lifted as he looks down and sighs.

medium shot, eye level: Mr. Choi on the left in front of the patched canvas tent, which seems to bulge with noise from inside; he pauses, dabs his forehead with a white handkerchief and mutters a rehearsed line to himself, lips barely moving, eyes on the tent flap. Clear afternoon light from the right.

tall panel split horizontally into three frames, a slow tilt up. 1: extreme close-up, low: a puddle on the mud trembling with orange ripples. 2: the ripples rising into the sole of Mr. Choi's shiny shoe, its tip stopped in the mud, the trembling climbing his ankle and knee. 3: insert inside the tent: Deoksu, eyes closed, drawing one long bow stroke on the oil-can cello, the orange light band wavering once, then straight again.

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: bust shot, low angle: Mr. Choi standing still with the handkerchief in his fist, a single bead of sweat running down his temple, not wiping it. Bottom: he lifts his head toward the corrugated tin roof of the junk shop next door, a puzzled face; above the roof a strip of clear cloudless sky.

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: medium shot: Mr. Choi's hand rising toward the tent flap, stopping just before touching it, then lowering as he turns back toward the embankment road. Bottom: insert, extreme close-up of a small pocket notebook in his hand with one freshly written line of unreadable handwriting, a ballpoint pen, the embankment road behind in late afternoon light.

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: high angle from a frosty market alley sign down to Seonyoung at the shop door, a sign with one character half fallen and dangling, unreadable; she straightens her glasses. Bottom: inside the narrow pawnshop under a flickering yellowed light: the empty violin case open on the glass counter, sheet music and a candy bag on red velvet, the violin's place empty; Seonyoung smoothing creased plain fictional bills with no real currency design; the pawnbroker at his abacus.

medium shot, eye level: the pawnbroker on the right licking his finger and counting the plain fictional bills twice (no real currency design), then bringing a rubber stamp down hard on a pawn ticket; Seonyoung on the left flinching, then leaning in hesitantly with a question, fingers on the counter edge. Yellowed fluorescent light.

bust shot, eye level: the pawnbroker on the right answering without lifting his eyes from the abacus; Seonyoung on the left smiling quickly and nodding, eyebrows lowered, slipping the pawn ticket back between the sheets of music. Flickering yellowed light.

tall panel split horizontally into three frames. 1: low angle tilt up from mud-caked rubber boots past a field-jacket hem and neck towel to Manseok's face last, entering under the door bell. 2: Seonyoung turning with the case in her arms and bumping his arm; he silently steps aside. 3: point-of-view shot from Manseok: through the half-closed lid, red velvet, a candy bag and the empty hollow where a violin should lie.

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: insert shot: Manseok's long-fingered hand holding out a yellowed, much-folded pawn ticket over the counter without setting it down, the fold worn white and the item name lost in the fold, unreadable. Bottom: the pawnbroker reading the date through his loupe and clicking his tongue; Manseok's lowered face at the frame edge.

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: extreme close-up, high angle: Manseok's thumb slowly rubbing the date on the worn pawn ticket, with unreadable blank strokes suggesting text, the ink not fading; the fluorescent light flickering, quiet composition. Bottom: his gaunt profile, eyes lowered, speaking very low as he folds the ticket along its worn crease and slips it into his inner pocket.

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: extreme close-up of a radio speaker on an electronics shop display; one long wine-colored light ribbon stretches out of it into the frosty alley, while behind, Manseok walking out of the alley quickens his pace. Bottom: extreme close-up of a handcart wheel rolling away on the frozen ground, the wine ribbon thinning and fading to nothing. Cold morning light, breath vapor.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, rubber boots, bare hands (the white cotton gloves stuffed in the jacket pocket)

cut_en: panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: static shot of the soaked tent roof sagging under heavy rain. Bottom: medium shot inside: Eunju in the center playing the tin-can violin to the beat of the rain, golden light waves riding the rain streaks; Deoksu hugging the oil-can cello, Dongmin by the drum, Mija listening with the trumpet on her knees; the spoon baton alone on the empty platform. Gray dull light through wet canvas.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, rubber boots, bare hands (the white cotton gloves stuffed in the jacket pocket)

cut_en: extreme close-up, side view, slow push-in on Eunju's left ear, her head tilting slightly to the left; the golden music shrinks away and through the rain small pale blue rings approach from far off, limping in pairs, one beat lagging. Gray dull light through wet canvas, rain streaks out of focus.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, rubber boots, bare hands (the white cotton gloves stuffed in the jacket pocket)

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into three frames. 1: extreme close-up of the bow stopped on the strings, Eunju's eyes turned to a gap in the tent, gray daylight. 2: Dongmin hiding the wooden-spoon drumsticks behind his back, eyes wide. 3: over Eunju's shoulder, the tent flap thrown open: Manseok standing in the doorway in a soaked field jacket, rain dripping from his neck towel, eyes sweeping over the scrap instruments.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, rubber boots, bare hands (the white cotton gloves stuffed in the jacket pocket)

cut_en: extreme close-up, high angle, two hands: Manseok's long wet fingers closing around the wooden-spoon neck of the tin-can violin; Eunju's fingers underneath loosening on their own; rain dripping from the frayed field-jacket cuff. Dull gray light, rain beyond the tent opening out of focus, the scene tense and quiet.

wide shot from inside the tent past the back flap into the rain: a tall mound of wet trash waiting for the collection yard, nobody near it; Manseok seen only from behind, stopped in front of the empty mound, the tin can in his hand, his arm just beginning to lift at waist height, pointed only at the empty mound. Gray rain light.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, rubber boots, bare hands (the white cotton gloves stuffed in the jacket pocket)

cut_en: close-up, static camera, eye level, front view: Eunju's face frozen, lips slightly parted, eyes unblinking, no hands or objects in frame, rain-dimmed gray light on one side of her face, the tent interior out of focus behind her, rain falling past the open flap, quiet composition.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, rubber boots, bare hands (the white cotton gloves stuffed in the jacket pocket)

cut_en: extreme close-up, side view: Eunju's left ear, the rain streaks fading out; in front of her ear one tiny golden point of light bends, flickers and dies away, like a small bright crack. Eyes not visible, only the ear and loose wisps of hair. Dim gray rain light.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, rubber boots, bare hands (the white cotton gloves stuffed in the jacket pocket)

cut_en: panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: close-up of Eunju's face, breath held, eyes wide. Bottom: extreme close-up in front of the tent in the rain: Manseok's hand gripping the handcart handle again, tendons standing out on the back of his hand; beyond it his profile looking straight ahead, never toward the tent.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, rubber boots, bare hands (the white cotton gloves stuffed in the jacket pocket)

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into three frames. 1: Mija jumping up and shouting toward the tent opening, Dongmin bursting into tears, grandma Sunrye holding her ladle, silently looking out. 2: point-of-view shot from Eunju: the rain-soaked trash mound, endless tangled wet plastic, cans and wood, nothing else. 3: wide shot from behind: Eunju holding crying Dongmin's hand, the two small backs walking out into the rain.

outfit.eunju: the oversized navy work jacket worn over her clothes for warmth, worn trousers, no gloves, no boots, under a thin quilt

cut_en: panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: high angle looking down, static: the dark tiny room, Eunju lying under a thin quilt with her eyes open, a wooden box on the shelf by her head, a single drop falling from the eaves outside. Bottom: extreme close-up of her knuckle tapping twice on the thin plywood wall. Near darkness, faint cold light from the small window.

outfit.eunju: the oversized navy work jacket worn over her clothes for warmth, worn trousers, no gloves, no boots, under a thin quilt

cut_en: extreme close-up, side view: Eunju lying with eyes closed, her left ear twitching; the room's sounds fall away and from far outside pale blue ripples drift in irregularly, like something being rummaged through. Near darkness, the ripples the only soft light.

outfit.eunju: the oversized navy work jacket worn over her clothes for warmth, worn trousers, no gloves, no boots, under a thin quilt

cut_en: panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: point-of-view shot from Eunju lying down, through the tiny window: far away one flashlight beam sweeping over a trash mound and another light standing perfectly still beside it. Bottom: extreme close-up of Eunju's mouth and chin above the quilt, holding her breath. Deep darkness.

outfit.mija: a loose-fitting red cotton-knit tracksuit top with a single contrasting stripe down each sleeve, zip front, no logo, dark trousers, plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating and rubber boots, both muddy
outfit.deoksu: a blue plaid shirt over a stretched, slightly yellowed thin white cotton-knit sleeveless undershirt (a Korean 'running shirt', not an athletic tank top), plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating and rubber boots, both muddy

cut_en: panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: medium shot, low angle at a wet trash mound at night: Mija lifting plastic with a stick, Deoksu aiming a flashlight; beside them only an adult's rubber boots and a hand holding a flashlight are visible, face out of frame, its beam fixed on the children's feet. Bottom: wide shot of the dark mound with two small lights moving.

outfit.mija: a loose-fitting red cotton-knit tracksuit top with a single contrasting stripe down each sleeve, zip front, no logo, dark trousers, plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating and rubber boots, both muddy
outfit.deoksu: a blue plaid shirt over a stretched, slightly yellowed thin white cotton-knit sleeveless undershirt (a Korean 'running shirt', not an athletic tank top), plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating and rubber boots, both muddy

cut_en: panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: medium shot: Mija and Deoksu dozing against a pile of scrap sacks, gloves and boots caked with mud; Eunju standing in the bright doorway; old Kwak at the workbench, dried mud on his boots. Bottom: slow push-in close-up: Kwak lifting a cloth off the tin-can violin, wiped clean, a new bent fork set as the bridge, gleaming a little more than before. Afternoon side light from the doorway.

outfit.mija: a loose-fitting red cotton-knit tracksuit top with a single contrasting stripe down each sleeve, zip front, no logo, dark trousers, plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating and rubber boots, both muddy

cut_en: medium shot, eye level: Eunju on the right, her fingertips stopped at the edge of the workbench, not touching the violin; Mija on the left slumped against the sacks, opening just one eye to talk, then closing it again. Afternoon side light, dust in the air.

outfit.deoksu: a blue plaid shirt over a stretched, slightly yellowed thin white cotton-knit sleeveless undershirt (a Korean 'running shirt', not an athletic tank top), plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating and rubber boots, both muddy

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into three frames. 1: close-up of Deoksu asleep against the sacks, eyes closed, only his mouth moving. 2: extreme close-up of Eunju's mouth, the corners lifting very slightly and settling back, no open smile, no teeth. 3: old Kwak, back straight, pointing with his chin toward a small plank door at the back of the shop. Afternoon light.

outfit.eunju: the oversized navy work jacket zipped to the chin, a gray hand-knitted scarf, worn trousers, worn canvas sneakers, bare hands (the cotton gloves stuffed in the jacket pocket), no boots

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into three frames. 1: inside the plank workshop, light through the gaps: the children unpacking their scrap instruments, Seonyoung raising the spoon-handle baton, Eunju lifting her bow. 2: static shot of the tin-can violin lying on a shelf under a cloth. 3: at dusk at a shack door, Eunju pulling Dongmin inside by the hand, a finger to her lips; Dongmin pressing his lips shut.

medium shot, side view: on an overcast day Manseok pulling his handcart past the back of the tent, his gaunt profile, his eyes flicking to the trash mound for a moment and then back to the road ahead. Flat gray light.

outfit.kwak: a gray knitted vest over a canvas work apron and a faded gray long-sleeved work shirt, dark work trousers, cloth arm sleeves, a knitted wool hat
outfit.eunju: the oversized navy work jacket zipped to the chin, a gray hand-knitted scarf, plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating with the fingertips cut off, worn trousers, worn canvas sneakers, no boots

cut_en: close-up, high angle: in the early-winter workshop beside a coal brazier glowing orange, old Kwak snipping the fingertips off Eunju's cotton work gloves with scissors; Eunju, gloves now fingerless, blowing warm breath on her fingers before picking up the bow. Cold daylight through plank gaps mixed with warm brazier glow.

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: insert of a new paper pinned on a weathered notice board, two red seal stamps, unreadable blank columns suggesting text, a corner flapping in the wind. Bottom: wide establishing shot inside the packed tent at evening, breath visible, a kettle steaming on the coal stove; Eunju and Dongmin at the very back, Manseok arms crossed at the entrance; Mr. Choi by the stove unfolding documents, sweat on his brow.

bust shot, eye level: Mr. Choi in his winter overcoat by the stove, reading stiffly from the document, eyes fixed on the paper, a damp handkerchief just passed over his forehead; the blurred heads of island people turning to each other behind him. Warm stove light and a bare bulb.

medium shot, eye level: grandma Sunrye on the left calling to Deoksu, the big boy on a front platform; in the right foreground Mr. Choi's hand with the handkerchief has stopped halfway to his forehead, his eyes resting on Deoksu for a moment. Warm stove glow, breath vapor.

medium shot, eye level: on the left an island man in dark padded work clothes and a head towel standing up to ask; Mr. Choi on the right answering without lifting his eyes from the document. Warm stove light, breath vapor.

medium shot, eye level: the scavenger woman on the left raising her voice, iron hook in hand; Mr. Choi on the right wiping his forehead again with an already damp handkerchief, answering in a stiff official manner, earnest. Warm stove light.

tall panel split horizontally into three frames. 1: Mija's mother standing up and speaking loudly; Mija leaping to her feet. 2: every head turned toward Mija; extreme close-up of her fist squeezing her red sleeve. 3: point-of-view shot from Eunju: the tent entrance where Manseok stood, now empty, only the canvas flap swaying in the wind. Evening stove light.

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: full shot on the dark embankment road at night: Mija kicking a tin can that flies off into the darkness; then a static shot of the empty dark where it vanished. Bottom: Mija speaking toward the dark without looking at Eunju; Eunju and Dongmin beside her; faint shack lights low in the distance, cold navy night.

close-up, high angle: Dongmin on the right tugging Eunju's hand and looking up, asking earnestly; Eunju on the left unable to answer, her eyes drifting to the darkness where the can disappeared; at the bottom of the frame their clasped hands, her grip tightening. Cold navy night light.

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: medium shot in the dim wings behind the stage curtain: the island children in their best clothes, Deoksu with his shirt buttoned to the throat, Dongmin licking his palm to smooth his buzz cut, Mija gripping her trumpet, Eunju with only a thin chain showing at her collar. Bottom: point-of-view shot from Eunju through the curtain gap, scanning the packed audience all the way to the doors.

full shot from the back of the hall: the island children walking out onto the wooden stage carrying a milk-can violin, an oil-can cello, a drainpipe trumpet and a paint-can drum, Seonyoung on the left; heads in the audience turning, some covering giggles. Stage light from above front, daylight from high windows.

medium shot, eye level: Seonyoung's back in the foreground, her raised baton trembling in midair; Dongmin on the left striking the drum too early, Mija on the right with the trumpet note cracking, cheeks puffed. Stage light from above front.

bust shot, eye level, front view: Eunju on stage with the tin-can violin under her chin, eyes lowered, lips closed, playing on; golden light rolls once around inside the can and walks out into the hall, while the surrounding audience fades. Stage light from above front.

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: wide shot of the audience gone quiet for a few bars, faces stopped; in the third row Taejun in his navy school blazer, not laughing, arms not crossed, eyes fixed forward. Bottom: extreme close-up at the end of his gaze: Eunju's left fingers stepping along the wooden-spoon neck of the tin-can violin. Stage light.

medium shot, eye level: on the stage in the background an MC reading from a sheet of paper; in the front of the audience Seonyoung leaping up with joy, her round glasses flying off and falling to the floor. Evening stage light, windows dark.

medium shot, eye level: Mija on the left thrusting her fist in the air, Dongmin in the center hanging off big Deoksu's belly, Deoksu on the right grinning gently; audience members behind them laughing. Evening stage light and house lights.

tall panel split horizontally into three frames. 1: extreme close-up, side view, push-in to Eunju's left ear as her head tilts left; the whole frame drained almost gray, no colored light at all. 2: extreme close-up of her hand rising halfway toward her ear and dropping back. 3: static shot of the closed auditorium doors. Dim evening light.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, rubber boots, bare hands (the white cotton gloves stuffed in the jacket pocket)

cut_en: panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: insert of a 1988 newspaper page spread on the platform, vertical columns, unreadable blank columns suggesting text, a tiny article in the bottom corner. Bottom: medium shot of the morning tent: the scrap-yard man tracing the lines with his finger as he reads aloud, island people eating rice soup around him, Eunju at the end of the platform holding her spoon. Morning diffused light, soup steam.

medium shot, eye level: the scrap-yard man on the left slapping the newspaper and laughing; the scavenger woman on the right waving her hand dismissively, half laughing; island people at the low platforms laughing out loud. Morning diffused light, steam.

medium shot, eye level: the newspaper passing from hand to hand across the low platforms; an island man in a dark padded work jacket and head towel in the center chuckling; other island people in dark work clothes with a few red and blue tops repeating the words to each other. Morning diffused light.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, rubber boots, bare hands (the white cotton gloves stuffed in the jacket pocket)

cut_en: extreme close-up, high angle: Eunju's hand setting her spoon down; as it touches the rice-soup bowl one pale blue ring spreads wide from the rim, while the laughing people in the background are blurred and nobody turns. Morning diffused light.

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: medium shot: Eunju's back small in the background leaving the tent; grandma Sunrye snatching the newspaper from the scrap-yard man's hand. Bottom: static insert of the newspaper folded with the article on top, laid at the end of the low platform. Morning diffused light.

tall panel split horizontally into three frames. 1: Manseok sitting at the end of the platform; grandma Sunrye silently setting a bowl of rice soup beside the folded newspaper. 2: extreme close-up of his long finger on the article, unreadable vertical columns, the fingertip pressing until the paper crumples. 3: static shot of the untouched bowl and a few plain fictional coins with no real currency design left beside it, the thin steam fading away. Midday diffused light.

medium shot, static camera, back view: old Kwak seated at the workbench with his back to camera, his sanding hand stopped; low red sunset light through the plank gaps turns his back almost into a silhouette. Beyond him Eunju lifts the tin-can violin from the shelf and is about to leave the frame. He does not turn.

tall panel split horizontally into three frames. 1: Eunju climbing the trash slope hugging the tin-can violin, white plastic underfoot. 2: wide shot of the flat hilltop, the sky beyond the river setting a dull muddy brown with no gold. 3: Eunju laying the violin down on a flat board, the same spot where it first sounded. Diffused dusk light, soft shadows.

outfit.mija: a loose-fitting red cotton-knit tracksuit top with a single contrasting stripe down each sleeve, zip front, no logo, dark trousers, plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating, rubber boots

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into three frames. 1: extreme close-up of Eunju's gloved fingers loosening the wooden pegs one by one, strings going slack. 2: static shot of the tin-can violin lying on the board with slack strings, empty and silent. 3: low angle against the sky: Mija in work gloves and rubber boots running up the slope out of breath, her red tracksuit top puffed by the evening wind, shouting. Dull dusk light.

outfit.mija: a loose-fitting red cotton-knit tracksuit top with a single contrasting stripe down each sleeve, zip front, no logo, dark trousers, plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating, rubber boots

cut_en: medium shot, side view: Eunju on the left standing up and speaking flatly without looking at Mija; Mija on the right stopped short; a gust makes the white plastic sheets all over the hilltop flap at once between and behind the two girls facing each other. Dull diffused dusk light.

outfit.mija: a loose-fitting red cotton-knit tracksuit top with a single contrasting stripe down each sleeve, zip front, no logo, dark trousers, plain white knitted cotton work gloves with no rubber coating, rubber boots

cut_en: panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: long shot from behind Mija in the foreground: Eunju walking past her and down the slope, growing small, not looking back; Mija shouting at her back. Bottom: wide shot of the tin-can violin left alone on the flat board under the dull darkening sky. Muddy dusk light.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, socks, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: medium shot, eye level: a small folding table under one dim bare bulb; Eunju on the left, Dongmin in the middle looking back and forth and talking, Manseok on the right eating in silence. A small inset at lower right: extreme close-up of Eunju's spoon stopped above her bowl. Dim heavy warm light.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, socks, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: close-up: Dongmin with a spoon in his mouth tilting his head, asking; Eunju with her head down answering curtly. Bottom: slow push-in on Manseok's face, his chopsticks stopped above the rice bowl, looking at Eunju, who keeps her head down. Dim bare bulb light.

outfit.eunju: an oversized navy work jacket (hand-me-down), worn trousers with frayed knees, socks, no gloves, no boots

cut_en: tall panel split horizontally into three frames. 1: under a bare bulb Eunju opening a wooden box with an old transistor radio inside. 2: side view close-up centered on her hands: the chain she lifts off catches on her rubber band and pulls it loose, her hair now loose, face at the frame edge. 3: static top-down insert: a silver tuning fork dropping beside the radio, its thin chain coiling.

char_text.eunju: Eunju, 13-year-old Korean girl, 140cm, small and thin, sun-tanned skin, narrow small face, large long almond-shaped eyes, thick straight eyebrows, no bangs with the forehead visible, loose wisps of hair falling at both temples, faint freckles on nose and cheeks, long dark-brown hair let down loose over her shoulders, no rubber band, a small silver tuning-fork pendant on a thin chain, tilts her head slightly to the left when listening

outfit.eunju: the oversized navy work jacket worn over her clothes for warmth, worn trousers, no gloves, no boots, under a thin quilt

cut_en: panel split horizontally into two frames, a cross-section of the thin wall. Top: in deep navy darkness Eunju lying down in the side room on the right, hair now loose, not reaching toward the wall, an empty gap between her and the wall; she pulls the quilt up over her ears. Bottom: across the wall in the main room on the left, extreme close-up of Manseok's eyes open in the dark.

char_text.eunju: Eunju, 13-year-old Korean girl, 140cm, small and thin, sun-tanned skin, narrow small face, large long almond-shaped eyes, thick straight eyebrows, no bangs with the forehead visible, loose wisps of hair falling at both temples, faint freckles on nose and cheeks, long dark-brown hair let down loose over her shoulders, no rubber band, tilts her head slightly to the left when listening

cut_en: panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: faint navy night light from the window: Dongmin asleep with his mouth open, his head on Manseok's arm; Manseok carefully sliding his arm out as Dongmin mumbles and rolls over. Bottom: close by the door: Manseok taking a flashlight off a nail, then his long fingers resting on the side-room door handle and lifting away.

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: long shot from the foot of the slope at night: one small flashlight beam climbing the trash hill, a few stars over the black ridge of the big hill. Bottom: on the hilltop, the flashlight circle sweeping slowly over a broken flowerpot, torn plastic and a single rubber shoe, and something round glinting at the edge of the beam. Navy darkness, warm yellow beam.

tall panel split horizontally into three frames. 1: extreme close-up in the flashlight beam: the tin-can violin on the board, night dew on the can, the wooden-spoon neck darkened with damp, four slack strings. 2: Manseok crouched, lifting it, one slack string catching on his long finger. 3: unbuttoning his field jacket and tucking the can against his chest. Navy dark, warm beam.

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: medium shot at the dark junk shop door at night: Manseok knocking; the door opening, warm yellow light spilling out behind old Kwak standing front-on, reading glasses pushed up, wide awake. Bottom: extreme close-up of Manseok's two long-fingered hands holding out the dew-wet tin-can violin, his eyes down on it. Yellow backlight in darkness.

panel split horizontally into two frames. Top: close-up: old Kwak's gaze resting on the long fingers under the can; he takes it silently and nudges an empty apple crate inside the doorway with his toe. Bottom: very high wide shot of the whole dark island at night, a single thread of yellow light leaking from the junk shop window, the only light on.

outfit.eunju: the oversized navy work jacket worn over her clothes for warmth, worn trousers, no gloves, no boots, under a thin quilt

cut_en: extreme close-up, side view: Eunju deeply asleep in navy darkness, hair now loose on the pillow, the quilt pulled up half over her left ear; the ear does not move; only faint navy moonlight from the small window falls on the ear, no glow, no light rings. The lower part of the frame is empty darkness for a narration box. Quiet composition.
